channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Efeito Gabrielli' mostra o velho na política de Lula
item.description: Dario Durigan, Fernando Haddad's substitute at the Finance Ministry, acted as a campaign firefighter during Lula's re-election bid to dampen the fallout from behind-the-scenes talks between Faria Lima representatives and Sérgio Gabrielli, coordinator of the government program. These exchanges stirred political noise over alleged financial sector influence on the government's economic agenda. The episode, dubbed the 'Gabrielli Effect,' highlights tensions between the PT and market sectors over the direction of economic policy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Caiado realizam convenções partidárias neste final de semana; entenda como funcionam
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) hold their party conventions this weekend in São Paulo, where they will be confirmed as presidential candidates. Flávio faces a campaign crisis, lacking a running mate and with key allies (União Brasil/PP and Republicanos) remaining neutral, while Caiado has Gilberto Kassab as his running mate and aims to gain traction against Lula, polling at 4% compared to Flávio’s 32% and Lula’s 40%.

item.title: Governo não vê problema em presença de Milei na convenção de Flávio, mas responderá falas sobre questões internas
item.description: Lula's government sees no issue with Javier Milei attending the PL convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro as its presidential candidate, but plans to respond if Milei comments on internal Brazilian matters like electronic voting or Lula himself. Flávio Bolsonaro arrives at the convention without a running mate, seeking a woman to bolster female voter support, after Tereza Cristina declined and the PP-União Brasil federation declared neutrality. The Argentine embassy informed Brazil of Milei's attendance, but no meeting request was made.

item.title: Metrópoles é vencedor do Prêmio Gabo de Jornalismo de 2026
item.description: The Metrópoles report 'A Política da Bala' won the 2026 Gabo Prize in the Coverage category, exposing police lethality in São Paulo under Tarcísio de Freitas and Guilherme Derrite. The investigation found 85 unarmed people killed and 47 shot in the back, suggesting a possible 'death squad' within the Military Police.

item.title: Renan Santos denuncia cantora à PF por fala interpretada como incitação à violência
item.description: The campaign of candidate Renan Santos (Mission) filed a complaint with the Federal Police against singer Sophia Chablau for remarks interpreted as incitement to violence during a show in São Paulo. In her statement, Chablau criticized Renan’s presence in independent music venues, suggesting his supporters should be 'ever further away, ever more dead.' The complaint warns of potential future confrontations at shows, particularly in major capitals.

item.title: Lula prioriza campanha em São Paulo, e PT direciona anúncios para cidades-chave no estado
item.description: The PT has prioritized São Paulo in President Lula's re-election campaign, launching events and online advertising in key cities across the state starting in the coming days.

item.title: O que a nova pesquisa Datafolha mostra sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio e a terceira via
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Lula at 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 32% in the first round, with other candidates clustered within the poll's two-point margin of error, preventing any clear third-way alternative. In runoff simulations, Lula holds a stable lead over Flávio (48% to 43%) and also leads over Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema by wider margins.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra os grupos que fazem as piores avaliações do governo Lula
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows that disapproval of Lula's government is highest among men (43%), Southern residents (46%), those with higher education (48%), and evangelical voters (51%), all above the national average of 38%. Approval stands at 32%, with 28% rating the government as regular. In the presidential race, Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff (48% to 43%) and in the first round (40% to 32%).

item.title: Qual deve ser o foco de Michelle em vídeo que será exibido na convenção de Flávio após reconciliação
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is preparing a video for the PL convention aimed at engaging female voters and showing support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy, following their reconciliation. Although she will not attend in person due to family commitments, she plans to play a strategic role through social media and women-focused initiatives.

item.title: Moraes revoga medidas cautelares contra ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo preso em operação da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes revoked all precautionary measures against former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella, who was arrested in flagrante during PF's Operation Unha e Carne. The decision, made on the eve of Rio de Janeiro's party conventions, allows him to stop wearing an electronic anklet, regain his passport, and be freed from other restrictions. Canella credited the revocation to his faith, while the investigation cites R$7.6 billion in financial movements and the seizure of weapons, including a military rifle from the Rio de Janeiro State Police.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que poderá romper concessão da Trivia Trens se empresa não cumprir o contrato
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas threatened to terminate the concession contract for the 11-Coral, 12-Safira, and 13-Jade train lines if the operator, Trivia Trens, fails to fulfill contractual obligations. He made the statement during a public event, emphasizing the need for improved rail service for passengers. The move underscores the state government’s stricter oversight of public transportation concessions.

item.title: O “grave alerta” de Caiado após novo Datafolha
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) issued a 'grave warning' following new Datafolha poll results showing high rejection rates for President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Caiado stated these figures make 'any healthy debate' about the country's future impossible, citing 46% rejection for Lula and 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE realiza primeira Semana Nacional do Sistema Eletrônico de Votação entre 3 e 9 de agosto
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will hold the first National Week of the Electronic Voting System from August 3 to 9, featuring electronic voting machine demonstrations, educational activities, anti-disinformation efforts, and public events nationwide. The initiative aims to strengthen public trust in the electronic voting system, particularly among youth, by increasing awareness of its security, transparency, and auditability. Activities will be coordinated by the TSE and Regional Electoral Courts (TREs), aligned with campaign themes, with the official launch during the opening session of the Judiciary’s second semester.

item.title: O cenário da eleição de 2022 que se repete em 2026 e chama atenção, segundo diretor do Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: The 2026 presidential election is expected to repeat the 2022 scenario, with centrist parties remaining independent of both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Murilo Hidalgo of Paraná Pesquisas. Neither the PT nor the PL has formally secured support from key centrist parties like PP, União Brasil and Republicanos, reinforcing these parties’ strategy of autonomy. Javier Milei’s endorsement of Bolsonaro is likely to have limited electoral impact, as it mainly appeals to voters already supporting the candidate.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro recorre no STF contra suspensão de visitas
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro appealed to the STF to annul Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision that suspended visits and banned political-electoral dissemination during house arrest, arguing the restrictions violate constitutional freedoms and exceed the sentence. The measure was triggered by a letter signed by Bolsonaro published by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which breached the internet access ban. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year-and-3-month sentence for involvement in the coup plot and is currently recovering from bacterial pneumonia.

item.title: Renan ironiza resultado do Datafolha: “Preciso abrir distância do Augusto Cury”
item.description: Renan Santos, president of Missão, mocked the latest Datafolha poll results, in which he appears with 3% of voting intentions in the first round, ahead of Augusto Cury (2%) and Samara Martins (1%). He joked that he 'managed to surpass Samara from UP' and now needs to 'open distance from Augusto Cury'.

item.title: O argumento de Bolsonaro em recurso contra decisão de Alexandre de Moraes
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro has appealed to the Supreme Federal Court against a decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes that banned visits to his house arrest for 30 days, claiming the restriction violates his freedom of thought and expression. The measure was taken after his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, published a letter written by Bolsonaro on social media, breaching a court order prohibiting him from using the internet, even through third parties. The defense argues the restriction exceeds the sentence and the law, constituting an ideological limitation incompatible with Brazil's constitutional regime.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro faz transmissão com argentino e volta a questionar o sistema eleitoral
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro participated in a live broadcast with Argentine consultant Fernando Cerimedo and again raised doubts about the auditability of Brazil's electronic voting machines, reiterating his criticisms of the electoral system.

item.title: Tarifaço terá peso maior na política que na economia, diz Genial
item.description: Tariffs announced by the U.S. on Brazilian goods will have a greater impact on political and electoral debate in 2026 than on the Brazilian economy, according to Genial’s macro strategist Roberto Motta. He stated that 95% of the issue’s relevance lies in how it will be handled in elections and how the opposition responds, despite some sectors facing economic effects. Motta also noted that Brazil’s high Selic rate of 14.25% makes fixed income attractive to investors but suppresses interest in the stock market.

item.title: “Datafolha não pegou o efeito da reconciliação do Flávio e Michelle”, diz Sóstenes
item.description: PL Chamber leader Sóstenes Cavalcante said the Datafolha poll showing Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff had not yet captured the impact of the reconciliation between Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro. He argued that this rapprochement could shift voter intentions in favor of the PL candidate. The statement was made on Friday, the 24th, in an interview with O Antagonista.

item.title: Pré-candidato à Presidência promete iPhone de graça a quem fizer curso de empreendedorismo
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Leonardo Avalanche (PRTB) promises to give a latest-generation iPhone and one year of free internet to Brazilians who complete an entrepreneurship course, under his 'iPhone for Every Brazilian' plan, funded by reallocating federal advertising budgets. He claims the program will integrate citizens into the digital economy, generate extra income without affecting Bolsa Família, but provides no evidence or course details. Despite announcing his candidacy on July 14, he has gained little traction, failing to register in the Datafolha poll of January 24.

item.title: Estabilidade registrada no Datafolha traz alívio à campanha de Flávio, e PT mira em onda de desgastes para adversário
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows stability in the presidential race, with Lula at 48% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in voting intentions, a change within the margin of error. Despite the stability, Flávio’s campaign views the result optimistically, expecting that his recent reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro will improve his standing in future surveys, while the PT bets on the cumulative wear and tear of the opponent to weaken him over the electoral period.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chega a convenção com cartas na manga, mas sem coligação e empacado nas pesquisas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro arrives at the PL party convention in São Paulo to launch his presidential candidacy, but remains isolated in electoral alliances and lagging in polls. His team is pushing to name a female running mate — potentially Michelle or Fernanda Bolsonaro — to appeal to women voters, though no decision has been made. The government program is ready and will be released upon candidacy registration in early August, while reconciliation with Michelle remains tenuous despite his public apology.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é rejeitado por 48% e Lula, por 46%, mostra Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro with 48% rejection and Lula with 46%, making them the most rejected presidential candidates for 2026. Despite campaign crises for Bolsonaro and U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, rejection levels remain stable, with Lula leading in all voting intention scenarios. The survey, conducted July 22–24 with 2,004 voters, has a 2-point margin of error and is registered with the TSE under BR-01166/2026.

item.title: TSE tenta há cinco meses notificar escola que homenageou Lula
item.description: The Novo Party is urging the TSE to serve notice on Acadêmicos de Niterói, a samba school accused of premature electoral campaigning in favor of President Lula, following its February 15 Carnival parade honoring him. The TSE has struggled for five months to formally notify the school, which denies any electoral intent in the tribute.

item.title: Lula exalta Vargas e diz que ex-presidente quebrou tradição conservadora
item.description: Lula praised Getúlio Vargas for breaking conservative traditions by establishing the minimum wage in 1936 and the CLT in 1943, stating that before these reforms, workers lived in conditions akin to slavery. He criticized the ongoing ideological resistance to Vargas, noting the lack of public tributes in São Paulo and highlighting the social transformation at USP, where half the students are now Black, brown, or from peripheral areas. Lula argued that those opposing equal opportunities for the poor and rich are unwilling to accept social progress.

item.title: Oposição pede urgência para derrubar decreto de Lula sobre big techs
item.description: Opposition leaders in the Senate filed an urgency request to overturn Decree No. 12.975 signed by President Lula, which alters digital platform liability rules under the Marco Civil da Internet, claiming it oversteps executive power and threatens free speech ahead of the 2026 elections. They demand an extraordinary session to vote on PDL 470 alongside PDLs 398, 460, and 467, which address the same issue, arguing that only Congress can legislate on such matters.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro recorre contra restrição a visitas e manifestos políticos
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro filed an appeal against a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that banned political-electoral manifestations and visits to the former president. The appeal seeks to restore Bolsonaro's active participation in the 2026 electoral campaign, arguing that the restrictions violate his political rights and freedom of expression. This move is part of Bolsonaro's effort to re-enter the presidential race despite electoral ineligibility rulings.

item.title: Datafolha: para 38%, gestão Lula é ruim ou péssima; 32% acham boa ou ótima
item.description: The Datafolha poll released on July 24 shows that 38% of the population evaluates President Lula's management as bad or terrible, while 32% consider it excellent or good and 28% as regular. Approval (49%) and disapproval (48%) remained stable within the margin of error, with health (21%), public safety (19%), and economy (14%) as the top public concerns.

item.title: Datafolha: após novo tarifaço dos EUA, aprovação do governo Lula fica estável
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows stability in President Lula's government approval, with 32% rating it as excellent/good, 38% as bad/terrible and 28% as regular, within the margin of error. Overall approval stands at 49% and disapproval at 48%, maintaining the balance seen in prior surveys. Despite the new U.S. tariffs, the government's image remained largely unaffected, with Catholics, Northeasterners and elderly being the most supportive, while men, evangelicals and Southern residents are the most critical.

item.title: Lula tem 48% e Flávio Bolsonaro soma 43% no segundo turno, aponta pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads a simulated second-round presidential race with 48% voting intention, compared to 43% for Flávio Bolsonaro, according to a Datafolha poll released Friday. Lula gained one percentage point since the previous survey, within the margin of error, while Bolsonaro held steady.

item.title: Lula aparece à frente de Flávio no 2º turno, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on Friday, July 24, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical 2026 presidential election runoff, with 48% voting intention versus 43%. The survey was conducted between July 22 and 23 among 2,004 voters in 139 municipalities.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: Lula é aprovado por 49% e desaprovado por 48%
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll shows President Lula's government with 49% approval and 48% disapproval, remaining stable within the margin of error. Negative ratings (ruim/péssimo) hold at 38%, while positive ratings (ótimo/bom) are at 32%. Health (21%) and public security (17%) are cited as the country's top problems.

item.title: A avaliação de Lula a menos de 3 meses da eleição, segundo novo Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on July 24, 2026 shows that President Lula’s government approval remains stable: 32% of respondents rate it as excellent or good, 38% as poor or terrible, and 28% as fair, with a margin of error of two percentage points. The figures are identical to the June 20 survey, indicating stability in public perception of the government less than three months before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Datafolha: 38% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo; para 32%, é ótimo ou bom
item.description: The July 2026 Datafolha poll shows 38% of Brazilians rate Lula's government as poor or terrible, 32% as excellent or good, and 28% as regular, showing stability since June. Lula's approval stands at 49% and disapproval at 48%, indicating a highly polarized electorate. The survey was conducted July 22-24, shortly after U.S. tariffs of 25% on Brazilian goods took effect, a move Lula blamed on Flávio Bolsonaro's lobbying efforts in the United States.

item.title: Michelle não vai à convenção do PL e só mandará vídeo para Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will not attend the PL's national convention on July 25, 2026, in person, where Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy will be formalized. Instead, she will send a supportive video after publicly accepting Flávio's public apology, made one day prior, following weeks of estrangement over his comments about her role in PL Mulher. The reconciliation was brokered by Celina Leão, Damares Alves, and Rogério Marinho. Though her physical absence disappoints party leaders seeking a unity display, her video endorsement is seen as signaling continued campaign engagement, particularly in mobilizing female and conservative voters, as she runs for Senate in the DF.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 48% e Flávio, 43% em 2º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on July 24, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading the runoff scenario with 48% voting intention, compared to 43% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). The survey interviewed 2,004 people between July 22 and 23, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Registered with the TSE under BR-01166/2026, the study cost R$307,541.60 and was self-funded.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 48% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 43%, no 2º turno
item.description: Lula leads the presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro with 48% to 43% in a potential runoff, according to a July Datafolha poll, with a two-point margin of error. The results show stability compared to June, when Lula had 47% and Flávio 43%. Additional scenarios tested show Lula also leading against Ronaldo Caiado (48% to 40%) and Romeu Zema (48% to 40%).

item.title: Datafolha: Lula lidera corrida presidencial com 40%; Flávio Bolsonaro tem 32%
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race with 40% voting intention in the first round, against 32% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, maintaining a stable lead despite campaign crises for the PL, including U.S. tariffs and family conflicts. Lula also leads in all tested second-round scenarios, with Ronaldo Caiado (4%), Romeu Zema (3%), and Renan Santos (3%) following. The margin of error is 2 percentage points.

item.title: A disputa no 2º turno entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, em novo Datafolha
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro by 5 percentage points (48% to 43%) in a hypothetical runoff according to a Datafolha poll released July 24, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points. The president also leads over Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in other runoff scenarios, maintaining his advantage since the June poll.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula mantém vantagem para Flávio Bolsonaro em intenções de voto no 2º turno
item.description: Lula maintains a lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in second-round scenarios, with 48% against 43%, according to Datafolha. The gap widened from four to five percentage points, despite remaining within the margin of error. The U.S. tariff and internal campaign crises, including a clash with Michelle Bolsonaro and a funding request for a biopic, have impacted Flávio’s standing.

item.title: Flávio usa IA com Milei para convocar apoiadores a convenção do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released an AI-generated video alongside Argentine President Javier Milei, calling supporters to the PL national convention in São Paulo where his presidential candidacy will be formalized. The video references 'Mission: Impossible', portraying Flávio as 'Fox Bravo' and Milei as an ally in the 'mission to free Brazil from the reds'. Milei arrived in São Paulo to attend the event, reinforcing ties with the Brazilian right and criticizing the Lula government.

item.title: Centrão deve ficar neutro na eleição para presidente
item.description: The Centrão is expected to remain nationally neutral in the 2026 election, avoiding formal alliances with either Lula or Flavio Bolsonaro in the first round, while negotiating with the PT to prevent official support for the Bolsonaro candidate, which would increase his TV exposure. Despite his efforts, Flavio Bolsonaro is unlikely to secure formal backing from the Centrão, which prefers pragmatic regional alliances with left or right depending on local interests. This reflects the group’s non-ideological nature, focused on regional electoral gains and legislative bench strength rather than national ideological coherence.

item.title: Governo Lula vê pressão por big techs como influência eleitoral dos EUA
item.description: The Lula administration perceives pressure from U.S. Republican senators on Brazil’s digital platform regulation as an attempt to interfere in domestic political discourse, likening it to tactics used in prior trade disputes. A letter signed by 20 U.S. congressmen criticizes Brazil’s alignment with the EU’s Digital Markets Act and urges inclusion of the issue in bilateral trade negotiations. The Planalto rejects claims that the rules aim to control political content or harm foreign firms, stating their purpose is to combat abusive practices without stifling innovation.

item.title: Indígenas vão a Lula para tentar brecar dragagem acelerada do rio Tapajós
item.description: Indigenous leaders and social movement representatives met with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the Planalto Palace to request the suspension of the planned emergency dredging on the Tapajós River in Pará. They argue the project could cause environmental and social harm to traditional communities in the area.

item.title: Tarifas de Trump atingem 47,3% das exportações brasileiras para os EUA, diz governo
item.description: The Lula government estimates that 47.3% of Brazil's exports to the United States will be affected by the 12.5% tariffs announced by the Trump administration. This measure represents a significant impact on bilateral trade relations, particularly in sectors such as agribusiness and industry. The Brazilian government is evaluating diplomatic and commercial responses to mitigate the effects.

item.title: PL lança esposa de Alexandre Ramagem à Câmara dos Deputados
item.description: The PL party officially nominated Rebeca Ramagem, wife of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem, as its candidate for the Chamber of Deputies from Rio de Janeiro. Rebeca, a prosecutor from Roraima on leave, is campaigning while her husband, convicted by the STF to 16 years in prison for involvement in a coup plot and currently a fugitive in the U.S., faces a Brazilian extradition request. She claims to have been targeted after losing her remote work arrangement and having her salary suspended by the STF since December 2025.

item.title: Lula diz que Orçamento não cobre “da cabeça aos pés”
item.description: President Lula compared the Union Budget to an 'airplane blanket' that doesn't cover 'from head to toe', emphasizing insufficient resources to meet all needs. He announced a reduction in expenditure blocking from R$23.7 billion to R$17.9 billion in the 2026 budget, due to revised mandatory spending projections. He also defended government investment in education, rejecting the idea that public spending is merely a cost, and referenced his long-standing opposition to this view since 2003.

item.title: Valdemar diz que convidará Michelle de volta ao PL Mulher e espera que ela participe da campanha de Flávio
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto said he will invite Michelle Bolsonaro to return as head of PL Women, a position she resigned from last month. He hopes she will actively participate in Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Haddad diz que Tarcísio "não quer ganhar e vai perder" eleição em SP
item.description: PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, Fernando Haddad, stated that current governor Tarcísio de Freitas 'does not want to win and will lose' the 2026 election, suggesting the Republican has already shown intent to leave office for another race. Haddad made the comment during the PDT's state convention, which formalized support for the Haddad-França ticket and endorsed Marina Silva and Simone Tebet for the Senate. The speech took place at the Franco Montoro Auditorium in Alesp, bringing together leaders from the PT, PSB, Rede, PSol, PV and PCdoB alliance.
